articles.title: A Soup So Pink It Turned a Whole City Into a Party!
articles.summary: Imagine a festival where 100,000 people dress in pink and eat cold beet soup together. That's what happened in Vilnius, Lithuania, where a giant pink party celebrated šaltibarščiai. One visitor even built a suit of pink knight armor!

articles.title: U.S. Defense Boss Asks Asian Allies to Spend More on Military
articles.summary: At a big defense meeting in Singapore, U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told Asian countries to spend more on their militaries to balance China's growing power. He didn't mention Taiwan in his speech, which surprised many people. One expert said the speech was 'light on substance.'

articles.title: Pride Parades Are Losing Big Sponsors—Here's Why
articles.summary: Many Pride festivals across the U.S. are struggling because big companies are giving less money. Organizers say political pressure and fear of backlash are scaring sponsors away. In Pittsburgh, they're racing to fill a budget gap before their June parade.
